description:
## [1.0.1](https://github.com/andersonlucasg3/AppleMusic-DiLink/releases/tag/v1.0.1)

API 29 backport for Apple Music 7.0.0 on the BYD DiLink 3.0 (Android 10): landscape/tablet UI, minSdk 29, API 30 backport (WindowInsetsControllerCompat, Objects.requireNonNullElse, List.of, WifiInfo) and Play Integrity bypass. Validated end to end in Morphe Manager 2.3.0 on Android 16; runtime on the head unit is still untested.
